Steady.|Zev Senesca gives orders to Kit Valent|}} '''Kit Valent''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] who served as a [[pilot]] in [[Rogue Squadron]]. During the [[Battle of Hoth]], Valent was the [[gunner]] for [[Zev Senesca]]'s [[T-47 airspeeder]] under the [[callsign]] [[Rogue Two]]. Valent and Senesca both died when their airspeeder was shot down. ==Biography== ===Rogue Two=== Kit Valent was a native of the [[planet]] [[Huulia]] who served as a [[Rebel pilot|pilot]] for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War]] against the [[Galactic Empire]]. He was integrated into [[Rogue Squadron]], a group within the [[Rebel Alliance Starfighter Corps]] who, in [[3 ABY]], were stationed at the rebel [[Echo Base]] on the [[Water|ice]] [[planet]] [[Hoth]]. The [[squadron]] [[pilot]]s had to adapt to using the base's [[T-47 airspeeder|snowspeeders]] in the cold [[temperature]]s, with Valent flying as [[gunner]] for the pilot [[Zev Senesca]] under the [[callsign]] [[Rogue Two]]. When the rebels [[Luke Skywalker]] and [[Han Solo]] were stuck overnight outside Echo Base, Rogue Squadron were dispatched the following morning to search for them, with Senesca and Valent flying together. After flying along the [[Clabburn Range]] and over the [[Hanging Valley]], the squadron split up over the [[North Ridge]]. After picking up [[sensor]] readings, Rogue Two changed course and continued along the North Ridge until they reached the [[Lanteel Glacier]], where Senesca picked up a transmission from Solo and reported he and Skywalker's location back to base.[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2016)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']] ===Battle of Hoth=== {{Quote|Coming around.''"
"''Watch that crossfire, boys.|Zev Senesca and Luke Skywalker|}} Not long after being rescued, Solo encounted and destroyed an Imperial [[XJ9-CS14|probe droid]] near the base. Knowing this meant that the Empire was now aware of their location, the rebels began to prepare to evacuate Echo Base. When [[Imperial Army|Imperial forces]] were deployed to the surface of Hoth to destroy the base's [[V-150 Planet Defender|shield generator]], Rogue Squadron was deployed to aid rebel ground forces in delaying the Imperials. Flying out of [[Hangar 7]] just after the first of thirty rebel [[GR-75 medium transport]]s successfully passed through an Imperial [[blockade]] around Hoth, Rogue Squadron flew up the [[Nev Ice Flow]] to confront the Imperial [[All Terrain Armored Transport]]s of [[Blizzard Force]]. Rogue Squadron quickly discovered their [[airspeeder]]'s [[blaster]]s were unable to penetrate the [[walker]]s' [[armor]], but successfully took down a [[Blizzard 2|walker]] using a [[Magnetic harpoon|harpoon]] and tow cables. Skywalker, leading the squadron as [[Rogue Leader]], entered into formation with Valent and Senesca in their airspeeder and planned to try and take down another walker. Senesca ordered Valent to bring his harpoon to position three, but before they could launch the cables, Rogue Two was hit by fire from one of the walkers. Both Senesca and Valent were [[Death|killed]] in the strike, making them the first pilots in Rogue Squadron to perish during the battle.{{StoryCite|story=Rendezvous Point (short story)|book=From a Certain Point of View: The Empire Strikes Back}} {{Char-stub}} ==Appearances== *{{Film|V}} {{1st}} *''[[The Empire Strikes Back: So You Want to Be a Jedi?]]'' {{Ab|The Empire Strikes Back: So You Want to Be a Jedi?
